<thought>Using the most intense peak (m/z 180.0423) as the [M+H]⁺ ion, the neutral monoisotopic mass is 179.03498 Da. Matching this mass to combinations of C, H, and O gives the best fit with C₉H₇O₄ (calculated mass 179.03443 Da, within a few ppm). The isotopic pattern (≈10 % M+1) also supports ~9 carbons. Therefore the molecular formula is C9H7O4.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H7O4</final_answer>
